[RFCS.6.2] Relevant fields in the event-trace context:

| Field         | Meaning in an event trace                                                        |
|---------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `fact_id`     | The engine's id for the fact ([RFCS.6.9]); unique within the trace; echoed by `FactRetract` |
| `schema_name` | The schema's own name ([LIMP.13.1])                                              |
| `fact`        | Proto-encoded fact body, typed per the schema's `SchemaDef`                          |
| `ttl_ns`      | TTL at time of assertion; `0` = schema default                                   |
| `clock_ns`    | Engine **monotonic** clock at the assertion (ns); not wall time. Wall-clock anchoring is the header's `wall_start_iso8601` ([RFCS.4.8]) |
| `rule_name`   | Always `""`: a `FactAssert` records a host input ([RFCS.3.3])                  |
| `seq`         | The event's place in the delivered stream ([LFST.12.1]); always written ([RFCS.3.3]) |
| `event_id`    | deterministic UUID stamped on every assertion, derived from the run identifier, the tier identifier and `seq` by [RFCS.6.8]; it identifies the fact within this engine's stream only ([LFST.5.6]) |
